hero.title: Your Piano Journey Begins Here
hero.subtitle: Plug in your keyboard and learn, right in your browser

why.title: Why Sightread
why.subtitle: A few reasons to give it a try.
why.feature1_desc: Works with any MIDI file. We'll automatically detect which track is for which hand.
why.feature2_desc: Tempo controls and Wait Mode let you slow down and focus on accuracy.
why.feature3_desc: Falling Notes or Sheet Hero. Switch views to match how you learn.

theory.title: Master Music Theory
theory.desc: Dive into our beautifully designed interactive lessons. Learn about staves, clefs, notes, and the piano keyboard through stunning 3D glassmorphism illustrations.

connectivity.title: Seamless Bluetooth & USB MIDI Connection
connectivity.desc: Learning piano has never been smoother. Simply pair your electronic keyboard via Bluetooth MIDI or plug in with a USB cable — zero latency, instant note detection, and zero complex driver setup required.
connectivity.feature1_desc: Play freely without tangled wires with ultra-low latency wireless MIDI pairing.
connectivity.feature2_desc: Compatible with standard USB-C, MIDI DIN cables, and real-time audio pitch detection.
connectivity.feature3_desc: Get instant visual note feedback the exact millisecond you press a key on your piano.

cta.title: Ready to play?
cta.desc: Join thousands of musicians improving their sight-reading skills every day. Connect your MIDI keyboard and start instantly.
